assumptions: scalar values and standard built-ins; no shared mutable aliases, monkey patching or implicit flows.
branch feasibility unchecked
external rules are caller-supplied contracts.
explicit raises terminate; implicit exceptions, handlers and resource effects are outside this model.
finite origin sets; joins lose branch correlation; traces are derivations, not executable paths.

call_binding.binding: Bind positions, then exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: No evaluated/mutable defaults, unpostponed annotations, type parameters, used variadics, extra arguments, unpacking, async/generator calls, external-rule keywords or non-normalized names.
call_binding.defaults: Omitted slots use source-free immutable scalars; explicit arguments override defaults. Definition-time effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.definitions: ASCII module functions defer bodies with literal or prior known value defaults, including variadics. Calls require literal defaults. Annotations need a checked module-local future directive and at most 128 nodes; no await, yield, assignment or type unpacking.
call_binding.evaluation: Evaluate explicit values once in source order before binding.
call_binding.initialization: Literals, aliases, built-in references, exports and plain classes/instances are inert. Literal __doc__ writes to prior unchanged plain functions preserve scalar calls. Reads, collisions and other effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.invalid: Missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments leave analysis incomplete; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only slots; required or immutable literal defaults.
call_binding.variadics: Omit unused ASCII variadics whose names never occur in the body. Calls bind fixed slots; annotations follow definition rules.

expression_control.boundary: scalar truth and comparisons; no overloaded protocols or implicit exceptions.
expression_control.comparisons: ordered operands; each comparison result may be true or false.
expression_control.effects: join normal, sink and explicit-raise alternatives.
expression_control.evaluation: left-to-right; each operand once per expression transfer.
expression_control.selectors: Boolean and None literals, not, parentheses and nested selected expressions.
expression_control.unknowns: retain both alternatives; no variable or call-result truth specialization.

task.question: Which storage granularity makes retained scalar analysis useful across representative admitted task shapes?
task.corpus: Pipelines at 8/16 helpers, imported fanout at 8/24 and mutual recursion at 8/12, with twice as many independent source files.
task.oracle: Independent Python execution and AST byte coordinates; every cached result must agree with clean analysis at the same revision.
measurements: worker and native child peak RSS
task.conditions: Separate fresh workers, isolated cache directories, identical native binary, disabled native fact cache, rotating strategy order, three repetitions. OS caches are not flushed. Tokens are unavailable.
task.edit_boundary: Direct edits for benchmark tooling, SDK cache encoding, regression tests and docs; the existing body writer does not express this integrated change.
task.claims: A finite structural corpus within the scalar subset; no production workload, population speedup, partial-summary reuse, live-agent or source-proof claim.
diagnostics: Initial storage probe used a rejected 16384-step request; corrected to 4096 before any measurements.
The 24-helper pipeline exceeded the response budget and is a boundary case. The measured pipeline uses 16 helpers.
The recursive corpus was expanded after the probe so each recursive pair participates in the entry query.
With all recursive pairs participating, 24 helpers also exceeded the response budget. The measured recursive cases use 8/12 helpers; 24 remains a boundary case.
First repeated run stopped after passing pipeline comparisons to strengthen the auditor with scenario source-digest checks. No partial timing run is accepted.

scope: Six finite scalar workloads. Cold means empty flow store; native fact cache disabled. OS caches are uncontrolled. Isolated worker RSS includes startup; child RSS is the largest native child, not aggregate memory. Context bytes count canonical JSON responses, not model tokens. No general latency or partial-summary reuse claim.
